passage:
A group of students visited a recycling center for their science class. They expected to see clean bottles becoming new bottles. Instead, they saw a mountain of mixed plastic.
The worker explained that recycling is harder when people do not clean or sort things correctly. A bottle with food inside can make other materials dirty. Some plastic cannot be recycled by the center at all.
On the bus home, the students were quieter than usual. They had thought recycling was a simple ending. Now they saw it was only one part of the story.
The next week, they started a campaign at school: "Use less first. Recycle better second."
